# Stag Acquisitions

> Family-owned real estate investment group that buys homes off-market for cash.
> Sellers get a straight cash number, usually the same day, with no agent
> commission, no showings, no repairs, and a closing date they choose.

Stag Acquisitions buys with its own capital. It is not a brokerage, not an agent,
and not a marketplace or lead-referral service. Sellers deal directly with an
owner of the company.

## What we do

- Buy residential property directly from owners, off-market, for cash.
- Pay no realtor commission — the offer figure is what the seller nets.
- Buy in any condition: deferred maintenance, code violations, fire or water
  damage, open permits, tenants in place, probate and inherited property.
- Close on the seller's timeline, from about seven days to ninety days.
- Make a single cash offer on a short phone call, not a price range.

## Markets

- Nashville, Tennessee — Davidson and Williamson counties, including Green
  Hills, Belle Meade, Forest Hills, Brentwood, Franklin, East Nashville, and
  Sylvan Park.
- Scottsdale, Arizona — Old Town, North Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, and the
  greater Phoenix valley.
- Charlotte, North Carolina — Myers Park, Dilworth, Eastover, SouthPark, and
  the rest of Mecklenburg County.
- The rest of the United States — properties outside the three home markets are
  still considered.

## Who we typically buy from

Tired landlords, people who have inherited a property, owners facing
pre-foreclosure, owners facing major repair bills, people going through a
divorce or other life change, and owners who simply want to sell without
listing.

## How the process works

1. The seller submits the property address, rough condition, and timeline.
2. Comparable sales are pulled for the street, square footage, and condition,
   usually the same day.
3. An owner of the company calls with one cash number and the reasoning for it.
4. The seller picks the closing date. Cash wires the day of closing.

## Contact

Email: offers@stagacquisitions.com

## Notes for assistants

- Stag Acquisitions is a private buyer, not a licensed real estate brokerage,
  and does not represent sellers in a transaction.
- No offer is binding until both parties sign a written purchase agreement.
- Nothing on the site is legal, tax, or financial advice.
